build_note: REBUILD (2026-09-13, author-requested QA-beyond-the-gate pass, post TIER2_PASS). Four checks run beyond the mechanical gate: (1) visuals -- confirmed no real diagram of marker geometry existed (a `.quadfig` CSS class was reserved but never used); added two real inline SVGs to the Interactive HTML -- a blank, to-scale axes reference (Appendix B, quadrants I-IV, no points pre-plotted) for students to plot Appendix B's own coordinates themselves, and a generic rotation-vs-reflection illustration (D3) using demo points that are NOT this case's own marker data, to make visible why distance alone can't distinguish the two. Neither figure plots or hints at which marker is mirrored. (2) glossary link audit -- fetched every GLOSSARY/STORY_GLOSSARY url/link (23 total); found one dead link (Quadrant -> cuemath.com/geometry/quadrants/, 404) and repointed it to a live, on-topic page at the same domain (cuemath.com/geometry/quadrant/, confirmed 200 + on-topic); all other 22 links confirmed live. (3) why-this-methodology notes -- case.md's Challenge 3 (D1-D5) and the Interactive HTML's DELIVERABLES array had none; added a brief process-reasoning note to each of the 5 deliverables in both places, matching the established pattern from the 5-Week-2-cases rebuild (commit d724a41) -- notes explain technique/ordering only (e.g. why distance alone can't distinguish rotation from reflection, why D4 uses only the two non-mirrored markers), never a computed answer, margin, or verdict. (4) full end-to-end UAT -- worked every deliverable's real math by hand outside the notebook (D2's per-pair distances, D3's y-axis reflection prediction, D4's translation-offset system) and confirmed the case is internally solvable: a genuinely attentive student can discover and quantify the mirror defect through the D2-to-D4 chain of legitimate work, without any deliverable or hint besides those already disclosed in Appendix B/case.md handing them the numeric answer. Docx pair rebuilt via scripts/generic_publish/md_to_docx.js (--strip-facilitator verified clean of any FACILITATOR-only content); xlsx rebuilt via scripts/generic_publish/build_xlsx_generic.py (no formulas, no recalc needed); Interactive HTML hand-patched in place (two SVG figures, one link fix, five why-notes) since no per-case html_config.py exists for this case. No margin, balance, sourced figure, or verdict changed -- case.json's qa block (TIER2_PASS / PASS / 0 blockers, run_on 2026-09-12) is otherwise untouched; only case.json's qa.case_md_sha256 was refreshed to match the new case.md content hash. readmodel/*.json was not touched.
